summary_1line: Years after the war, Dhritarashtra repents, endures Bhima’s taunts, and asks Yudhishthira for permission to retire to the forest for penance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima slaps his massive arms in the royal hall, boasting they crushed Duryodhana and his brothers while the blind Dhritarashtra listens in silent anguish.
The aged blind king Dhritarashtra, leaning on Gandhari, trembles and nearly collapses after pleading with Yudhishthira for permission to retire to the forest.
Dhritarashtra secretly lies on kusa grass in deer-skin at night, fasting and reciting prayers in repentance while the palace believes he eats normally.
